Mira (Sales): Quick request — Gala.ai wants a hosted POC next Friday. They need a short demo spike and a longer smoke-test window. Can infra do an ephemeral key + rate exception?
Jon (Infra): Give me numbers and windows.
Mira (Sales): Peak 380 rps for 10 minutes (demo), then 65 rps for 3 hours (smoke). Streaming SSE from their backend. Low token payloads.
Cal (Platform): We can issue an ephemeral scoped key with a burst window and a fallback limit. Need static egress IPs or a proxy; streaming increases concurrent connection requirements.
Asha (Security): Requirements: server-to-server only (static IPs), key TTL <=72h (48h preferred), scope limited to generation only, logs redacted, no raw payload export. Need SOC contact.
Mira (Sales): They can egress from 203.119.77.0/24 and 203.119.78.0/24. TTL 48h. SOC contact: security@gala.ai.
Jon (Infra): I'll plan: burst_rate=380 rps window=10m, sustained_rate=65 rps until end_time, conn_limit=130 for this key. Create a ticket and post the key here when ready.
Rae (SRE): I'll create a dashboard and set alerts to #eng-oncall: error_rate > 2% or p95 latency > 1.4s. Also watch SSE connection churn.
Mira (Sales): Demo window: 2028-08-14T18:00:00Z - 2028-08-14T21:00:00Z, demo spike 18:30-18:40Z. Ticket REDWOOD-POC-613 created.
(deploy-bot 18m later): Ephemeral key provisioned: id ephem_g7e1a, scope=generation:invoke, expires in 48h, IP allowlist applied. See REDWOOD-POC-613.
Jon (Infra): Sample curl (replace <KEY>):
```
curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"rw-gpt-7b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"give me top 5 recs"}],"stream":true}'
```
Cal (Platform): Note: concurrent connection limit bumped to 130 for this key. Token tracing disabled, redaction on. Scope locked to generation-only.
Mira (Sales): Sending to Gala now. They asked: if they sustain 65 rps for a month, what's a rough monthly run-rate?
Cal (Platform): Ballpark ~ $1.7k/mo for sustained 65 rps on rw-gpt-7b. I'll put a formal estimate in the ticket.
Gala (customer via email): Smoke test hit ~360 rps streaming, no errors.
Rae (SRE): Monitoring live. If they go over sustained outside the demo window we'll failover to a lower-cost model and post status in REDWOOD-POC-613.
Asha (Security): Confirmed minimal logs retained for 7 days. Key will auto-expire per TTL.
Mira (Sales): Thanks everyone, will update customer. :thumbsup:
